title: operations.successful is true for operations of a failed transaction that stellar-core rolled back
severity_basis: ConvertOperation takes successful from the operation's own result code only, so every operation coded op_success in a transaction that failed with txFAILED or txFEE_BUMP_INNER_FAILED is stored as successful although stellar-core rolled it back, and the API documents the field as whether the operation succeeded. A silent wrong value in a secondary field of account history, common on pubnet; no state change is attached to these operations, so balances are right.
caps_note: No CAP applies: a failed transaction rolling back its operations is classic behaviour that predates CAPs.

entries.expected: every operation of a failed transaction is stored with successful = false: transaction 34a69fbc… of pubnet ledger 65484612 is txFAILED, and its second operation (PAYMENT, coded op_success) was rolled back with it
entries.observed: The entry holds the ledger and states the transaction's successful = false, its result codes and no operation meta; no replay of the kit compares an operation's successful field (the expectation vocabulary has none). By hand at 18db88f4 on this ledger: 195 of the 868 stored operations have successful = true in a failed transaction, for example operation 2 (PAYMENT, op_success) of transaction 34a69fbc… (txFAILED).

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's test (internal/indexer/failed_ops_test.go) at wallet-backend 18db88f4 runs ProcessLedger on pubnet ledger 65484612 from the public data lake: 195 of 868 buffered operations are Successful while their transaction failed. An ingest of the same ledger at 3e22515a stored those 195 operations with successful = true (processors/utils.go and processors/codes.go are the same at 18db88f4).
evidence.expected_basis: When a transaction fails, stellar-core rolls back all of its operations, including those whose own result code is op_success; the transaction result says whether any of them took effect.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made at 18db88f4 before filing on 2026-11-19: 195 of 868 operations of pubnet ledger 65484612 are successful in a failed transaction.

queries: stellar/wallet-backend: every issue and pull request title, open and closed
stellar/wallet-backend: commits since 2026-11-01 on every branch touching the cited files
